create.name: Devin Berry
create.bio:
Devin Berry is an Insight Meditation teacher who has practised since 1999 and now serves as one of the Core Guiding Teachers at the Insight Meditation Society in Barre, Massachusetts. His grounding is in the early Buddhist teachings, especially vipassana and metta, and he has spent many long stretches in silent retreat. He trained through Spirit Rock's Dedicated Practitioners Program and the IMS teacher training that ran from 2017 to 2021. Before moving to Western Massachusetts he was a core leader of San Francisco's People of Color Insight Sangha and taught at East Bay Meditation Center in Oakland, where he helped start a sangha for teenagers and one for men of colour.

Today he leads residential retreats, daylongs and online gatherings across the United States, including month-long teaching periods at the Forest Refuge and retreats for Black, Indigenous and people of colour. Students describe a warm, down-to-earth style that leans on stories and humour while staying close to the classical path. With Tara Mulay he co-founded Heartstream Sangha, which meets online on the first Sunday of each month. He offers his teaching on a dana basis, writes essays on Substack, and has dozens of recorded talks freely available on Dharma Seed. He has also sat on the board of Insight World Aid.

courses.title: New Year's Eve Retreat 2026
courses.description: An online day of practice with IMS, co-taught with Tara Mulay, that runs from midday on 31 December into the first minutes of the new year. Sessions mix mindfulness, lovingkindness and guided reflection on intentions for the year ahead, with an optional sit through midnight Eastern time.
courses.price: $50, $100 or $150 USD (choose your rate; fee waiver available)

courses.title: Forest Refuge: March 2027 with Rebecca Bradshaw and Devin Berry
courses.description: A teaching month at the Forest Refuge, the IMS centre for longer silent retreat in Barre, shared with Rebecca Bradshaw. Retreatants stay at least seven nights and can be guided in insight practice, lovingkindness or metta concentration.
courses.price: From $115 USD per night (2027 sliding scale, minimum 7 nights)

courses.title: Heartstream Sangha: First Sundays Online
courses.description: A monthly online gathering led by Devin Berry and Tara Mulay on the first Sunday evening of each month, with meditation and a talk in the Theravada tradition. Offered on a donation basis.

free_resources.title: Devin Berry's Dharma Talks on Dharma Seed
free_resources.description: More than forty recorded talks and guided instructions from retreats at IMS, Spirit Rock and elsewhere, free to stream or download. Topics include compassion, equanimity, the brahma viharas and the five recollections.
